Familiaridade com Git e fluxos de versionamento.Será um diferencial se você:

title: Assistente comercial

title: Sales executive - subsea
description:
About M&O PartnersM&O Partners is a multi‑disciplined professional services company providing sales development, strategic and operational services to the energy and maritime industries, with a strong presence in Brazil’s offshore market. From Rio de Janeiro, M&O supports international subsea and offshore technology providers in winning new business with Brazilian operators, EPCIs and contractors through local technical sales expertise and structured sales representation.Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Subsea is responsible for driving M&O Partners’ commercial development within the Brazilian subsea market, with a primary focus on acquiring new customers and opportunities for M&O’s supplier portfolio of subsea equipment, systems and digital solutions.
Reporting directly to the Senior Advisor – Subsea, the Sales Executive - Subsea will proactively identify prospects, open doors at target accounts, progress opportunities through the sales cycle, position M&O’s supplier portfolio and develop new client relationships with offshore operators, subsea contractors, and engineering companies.
The Sales Executive - Subsea will engage with key stakeholders across the Brazilian subsea value chain, providing technical insight and solution‑driven support to ensure client needs are met, supplier value is clearly articulated, and sales objectives are consistently achieved.
Success in this role is measured by new logos, qualified pipeline creation, closed new business and sustained satisfaction across M&O’s subsea supplier portfolio.Key ResponsibilitiesNew Business Hunting & Development
Proactively research, identify and prioritize target accounts in the Brazilian subsea ecosystem, including E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and engineering consultancies.
Execute structured outbound prospecting (calls, emails, Linked In, events) to secure first meetings with decision‑makers and influencers in engineering, operations, and supply chain.
Open and quality new relationships (“new logos”) for M&O in the subsea market, convert leads into commercial opportunities and manage the full sales process from prospecting to contract closure, handing over matured accounts for farming when appropriate.
Expand M&O’s reach among key players in the subsea market, ensuring ongoing engagement and account development.Product & Solution Representation
Develop a strong technical understanding of subsea products and services in the M&O portfolio, including equipment, systems, intervention technologies and software used in subsea operations and integrity management.
Lead initial discovery and capability meetings, presenting supplier solutions and tailoring the value proposition to Brazilian subsea project needs.
Coordinate deeper technical discussions with supplier specialists while maintaining commercial ownership of the opportunity.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier innovations, certifications, and subsea industry standards.Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor Brazilian subsea project pipelines, pre‑salt developments, brownfield tiebacks and intervention campaigns to time outreach and proposals effectively with M&O’s supplier portfolio (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs).
Map competitive offerings and routes‑to‑market, identifying white space and differentiation angles for M&O’s supplier portfolio.
Provide structured insights on projects, competitors and customer requirements to the Senior Advisor - Subsea and M&O’s supplier portfolio to refine targeting and positioning.Sales Process & Reporting
Support the development of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives for the subsea market.
Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, logging activities, contacts, opportunities, next steps and realistic pipeline forecasts.
Monitor proper use by M&O’s supplier portfolio in the subsea market of our CRM tool.
Report regularly to the Senior Advisor - Subsea on number of new leads and first meetings, pipeline volume and quality, stage progression and new business closed.Skills and Competencies
Technical Sales Expertise: Proven success in B2 B sales of technical/engineered solutions in subsea, offshore, SURF or related industrial environments.
Client‑Facing Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise value propositions for Brazilian subsea stakeholders at multiple levels.
Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable navigating Brazilian procurement processes, RFQs and tenders, and supporting commercial negotiations for high‑value contracts.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Uses market data and project intelligence to prioritize accounts, design prospecting campaigns and focus on highest‑potential opportunities.
Autonomy & Collaboration: Self‑starter who plans and executes their own hunting activities while closely aligning with the Senior Advisor and the Sales teams.
Language skills: fluent Portuguese and advanced English.Experience Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience within the subsea industry (ideally serving the Brazilian SURF market) with an active network of professionals.
Minimum 2 years of B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within subsea, offshore or engineered equipment sectors.
Demonstrated track record in outbound prospecting, generating new business and closing new accounts (not only managing existing ones).
Experience engaging with E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and intervention/service companies in Brazil.
Solid understanding of project‑driven, longer‑cycle sales and formal procurement environments and technical sales environments.

title: Especialista em criação
description:
Sobre a EmpresaA Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país.Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acessefugini.com.br.Especialista em Criação

title: Lead functional analyst / product owner
description:
Project Description:This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.Responsibilities:
Product & Backlog Management
Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug fixes, improvements, and release work
Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance criteria with stakeholder
Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
Release & Operational Ownership
Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
communication
Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for external testers, etc.)
Stakeholder Communication
Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
representatives of legal and regulatory departments
Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholdersMandatory Skills Description:
Product & Delivery Execution
Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
Experience managing multiple release timelines
Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed prioritiesQuality & Compliance Mindset
Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impactRelease & Operational Skills
Experience coordinating software releases end to end
Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)Tools & Ways of Working
Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
Ability to operate independently with limited guidanceStakeholder & Pressure Handling
Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalateLanguages:

Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida comoData Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQLpara construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática comAWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;

Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação comsegurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência emambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;

Sobre a Gruen
Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.
Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.
Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.
Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.
Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.Atribuições
Realizar projetos elétricos em plantas de energias renováveis (biogás).
Definir especificações técnicas do projeto.
Executar e supervisionar instalações internas e no cliente.
Definir sistemas de controle: arquitetura de rede, diagrama de interligação, lista de entradas e saídas, lista de materiais necessários para os projetos, memória de cálculo de dimensionamento de cargas e condutores.
Ser responsável pelo projeto elétrico completo de uma planta de biogás.
Auxiliar os técnicos elétricos com a montagem e/ou instalação em campo.
Criar e/ou adaptar software de projetos anteriores PLC e IHM (Siemens e Rockwell).
Realizar teste de equipamentos internamente e em fornecedores.
Identificar e realizar melhorias dos equipamentos.
Executar os startup e comissionamento dos equipamentos em conjunto com técnicos mecânicos, elétricos e outras pessoas envolvidas.
Ajustar e parametrizar diferentes equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos.
Controlar interfaces e funcionamento de todos os módulos.
Realizar Interligações e controle de funcionamento em diferentes sistemas de comunicações, como: Profinet, Profibus, PA, As-Interface e outros.
Auxiliar o Gerente de Projeto na aprovação dos equipamentos nos fornecedores, bem como no sistema completo de purificação de biogás na planta do cliente.

description:

The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Join Our Global Team:We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. title: Analista de pcp senior
description:

title: Gerente de suprimentos (ingredientes)
description:

Com mais de 70 anos de história, trabalhamos com foco em excelência, inovação, segurança dos alimentos e práticas de sustentabilidade. Somos um time de mais de 280 mil pessoas, alimentando o mundo com o que há de melhor!JBS no Brasil e no MundoA JBS é uma das maiores e mais reconhecidas empresas de alimentos do mundo, com uma presença global robusta. Globalmente:Mais de 70 anos de história
Mais de 280 mil colaboradores
Presença em mais de 20 países
Operações em mais de 500 unidades produtivas
Atendimento a mais de 275 mil clientes em 190 países

Presença em mais de 20 estados brasileiros
Presença em mais de 200 cidades no paísJunte-se à nossa equipe e faça parte de uma história de sucesso e inovação na JBS!Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsável por garantir o desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de suprimentos sustentáveis para atendimento das necessidades de ingredientes afins, com qualidade e preços referenciados no mercado a fim de assegurar a maximização dos resultados da companhia.Desafios:

Interface com o time de Global Procurement nas negociações estratégicas e sinergias globais.- Interface com o time de P&D, qualidade e Planejamento;- Garantir as análises tributárias, análises de risco, logísticas e elaboração de cenários para as aquisições das suas categorias- Gerir o volume de demandas com extrema organização, garantindo a adequada formalização das negociações e arquivamento dos documentos no sistema conforme processo de compra- Estudar, conhecer e prospectar mercado fornecedor, elaborando cenários com tendências de variação do custo para suportar o plano estratégico e orçamentário da empresa- Identificar oportunidades de redução de custo, melhoria das especificações e maior eficiência na gestão de consumo das suas categorias. Liderar e implementar iniciativas e projetos multidisciplinares que garantam redução contínua das despesas nas suas categorias, assegurando o atendimento das suas metas financeiras- Gerir indicadores de performance traçando planos de ação para atingir metas e tratando os desvios (Gerenciamento da rotina e gestão para melhorias)- Fomentar o aumento da eficiência em compras com a padronização das melhores práticas de processos garantindo melhoria do nível de atendimento e otimização contínua dos recursos- Conduzir projetos de excelência com consistência na aplicação das melhores ferramentas, garantindo o uso das novas tecnologias e digitalização da área para assegurar sermos os melhores em aquisição e gestão de Suprimentos- Assegurar a aplicação das políticas, modelos de contratação e estratégias que zelem pela governança e compliance na sua área gerência.Requisitos e qualificações:Superior completo (Diferencial Engenharia de Alimentos) ;Sólida atuação em gestão de processos de suprimentos de insumos e ingredientes (Materiais Diretos) e gestão de equipes em indústria;Ter atuado com Purchasing tools como Strategic Sourcing, annual sourcing plan, gerenciamento de contratos e metas, forecast estratégias de compras;Planejamento Orçamentário Anual (PO) da empresa;Gestão de reajuste de preços contratos / inflação (média x média, acumulado);Inglês Fluente;Desejável Espanhol;Pacote Office Avançado.Informações adicionais

title: Principal data engineer
description:
Description
We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.
This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.

Responsibilities
Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
Write production-ready Type Script code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and Dynamo DB.
Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.
Technology Requirements
5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
Experience writing production Type Script.
Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or Postgre SQL.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
Advanced SQL skills.
Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.
Profile Requirements
Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Product stewardship analyst (contractor)
description:
About us:
Archroma is a globally recognized leader in specialty chemicals, dedicated to creating a more colorful, sustainable, and efficient world. Our mission is to be the best partner for our customers, with a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability. With a rich heritage of more than 100 years, we continue to drive excellence in the chemical industry. As we expand our operations, we are seeking a qualified and dedicated professional in the technical commercial area of Paper to join our team.
Position Overview:
The Product Stewardship Analyst supports the business product steward/Manager in the activities of the regional regulatory compliance and marketability of Archroma’s products, raw materials, and traded goods. This contract role is responsible for research, collection and validation of regulatory data as per the global Product Stewardship strategy, maintaining regulatory databases, securing product certifications, and supporting teams in achieving chemical compliance and sustainability goals.
Key Responsibilities:
• Maintain and update product safety data in SAP-EHS, sales/marketing databases and other regulatory systems.
• Documentation of hazard assessments, GHS classifications, Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and product labels for assigned countries and languages.
• Prepare registrations dossier, regulatory reporting under the supervision of business Steward.
• Collaborate with sales, procurement, and supply chain teams to collect relevant data for chemical compliance. Provide timely and effective responses to customer inquiries regarding chemical safety, eco-labels, food contact assessments, and certifications.
• Compile & submit product compliance data accordingly to market & application standards.
• Secure certifications such as FDA, ecolabels, and customer-specific or brand requirements.
• Product safety data collection, validation and maintenance of company databases (e.g., SAP-EHS, The Safe Edge, Salesforce). Maintain accurate record-keeping of product safety information and customer communications.
Required Competencies:
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.
• 1-2 years of experience in product stewardship or Environment, Health, Safety department in a specialty chemical manufacturing company
• Fluency in English and Spanish is mandatory
• Quick learner with ability to work with moderate supervision and guidance Basic knowledge of Customer-focused mindset with a Can-do approach to problem-solving.
• Good analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

title: Junior data scientist - agronomy
description:
Kynetec is the global leader in agricultural and animal health market insights. We have a long history of market research expertise, specialising in animal health and nutrition, crop protection, farm machinery and equipment, seed/biotech and fertilisers.
Backed by a team of more than 850 market researchers, interviewers, data analysts, marketing scientists, research operation and data visualization specialists, our number one priority is to ensure that we deliver the highest-quality insight and foresight at the right time to enable our clients to confidently make the best decisions for their business.
Across the globe, our employees are located across 28 major agriculture and animal health countries. Our coverage extends to major and niche sectors of our industry, where we regularly undertake research projects in more than 80 countries.
We’re looking for a Junior Data Scientist to join and help grow our team in Piracicaba. This is a great opportunity for someone with an agronomy or agricultural background who loves working with data, analytics, and machine learning and wants to develop their skills in a supportive, hands-on environment. Training and development are a key part of this role.
You’ll work closely with multidisciplinary teams, helping turn agronomic data into insights, dashboards, and predictive solutions that support the agricultural sector. If you’re excited about data, agriculture, and developing your career as a Data Scientist, we’d love to hear from you.
Role responsibilities:
Perform data queries and manipulation in relational databases (SQL)
Develop, maintain, and optimise dashboards and reports in Power BI
Use Machine Learning to analyze data and create models that predict outcomes, to automate routine business or operational tasks
Support the development of ETL processes using Python scripts
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on the integration of agronomic data systems and products
What we’re looking for:
Experience with Power BI
Solid knowledge of SQL
Understanding of programming logic and data structures
Background or previous experience in agronomy or the agricultural sector
Genuine interest in data, analytics, and machine learning, with a willingness to learn and grow
Professional level verbal and written English
Nice to have:
Experience with Git, dbt, or Databricks
Knowledge of dashboard frameworks such as Plotly or R
Exposure to machine learning and automation tools
Understanding of basic design principles for data visualisation
Why join us?
Strong focus on learning, development, and mentorship
Opportunity to work with real-world agronomic data and make a tangible impact
Collaborative team environment with room to grow

title: Border patrol agent (bpa) - experienced (gl9 / gs11)
description:
Border Patrol Agent (BPA) - in the Federal Security and Public Safety Sector Experienced (GL-9 GS-11)
SAME MISSION, NEW DRIVE!
You love protecting your community and doing your part to keep our nation safe. But maybe you're looking for a change of scenery?
USBP is hiring immediately for full-time, career positions, where your prior law enforcement officer (LEO) experience may qualify you for higher-graded Border Patrol Agent (BPA) opportunities. Continue making a difference with the nation's premier federal agency charged with securing our borders and protecting our country.
Whether you gained this experience as part of a military police unit or as a member of a state or local law enforcement organization, you have an opportunity to work with highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission.
Check out the duties and responsibilities section below, along with the qualifications section to see if you are eligible. Now is the time to make your move, along with excellent base pay, location pay, exceptional benefits, and job stability, USBP is offering up to $60,000 in additional incentives to newly appointed Agents (see details below).
DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOW
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.
U. S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.
U. S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is hiring immediately for these full-time, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.
Salary and Benefits:
Salary for newly appointed law enforcement Border Patrol Agents varies from:
Base Salary: GL-9/GS-11, $63,148 - $120,145 per year
Locality Pay: Varies by duty location.
Overtime Pay: Up to 25%
Duty location impacts pay rates; locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression from GL-9 to GS-11 to GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without re-applying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in the lower grade level.
All Border Patrol Agents may select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health and insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan that is similar to traditional and ROTH 401(k) offerings.
*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX; Presidio, TX; Sanderson, TX; Comstock, TX; Lordsburg, NM; Freer, TX; Hebbronville, TX; Ajo, AZ.
*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.
Duty Locations: You will be asked to select your preferred location for one of the following mission critical locations:* Big Bend Sector Stations - *Presidio, Van Horn, *Sanderson, Alpine, *Sierra Blanca, Marfa
* Buffalo Sector Stations - Wellesley Island
* Del Rio Sector Stations - Del Rio, Brackettville, *Comstock, Eagle Pass North, Eagle Pass South, Carrizo Springs, Uvalde
* El Paso Sector Stations - Alamogordo, Clint, Deming, El Paso, Fort Hancock, Las Cruces, *Lordsburg, Santa Teresa, Ysleta
* El Centro Sector Stations - El Centro, Indio, Calexico
* Grand Forks Sector Stations - Pembina
* Havre Sector Stations - Havre, Malta, Plentywood, Scobey, Sweetgrass
* Houlton Sector Stations - Calais, Fort Fairfield, Jackman, Rangeley, Van Buren
* Laredo Sector Stations - Laredo South, Cotulla, *Hebbronville, Laredo West, *Freer, Laredo North, Zapata
* Rio Grande Valley Sector Stations - Rio Grande City, Fort Brown, Mc Allen, Brownsville, Falfurrias, Weslaco, Kingsville, Harlingen
* San Diego Sector Stations - Boulevard, Brownfield, Campo, Chula Vista, Imperial Beach, Murrieta, San Clemente
* Spokane Sector Stations - Colville, Curlew, Metaline Falls, Oroville
* Swanton Sector Stations - Beecher Falls, Burke, Champlain, Newport, Richford
* Tucson Sector Stations - *Ajo, Tucson, Nogales, Douglas, Brian A Terry, Sonoita, Casa Grande, Three Points Substation, Willcox
* Yuma Sector Stations - Blythe, Yuma, WelltonDuties and Responsibilities:
As a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and customs laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations.
* Preventing and apprehending aliens and smugglers of aliens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations.
* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband.
* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks.
* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.Qualifications:
GL-9: You qualify for the GL-9 grade level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as:* Performing physical searches of detained individuals, their vehicles, and their immediate surroundings for weapons, contraband, currency, and other evidence.
* Apprehending, physically restraining, or working with law enforcement officials to identify or apprehend violators of state, federal, or immigration laws.
* Proficient in the use of firearms, preparing investigative reports, serving court orders (e.g., warrants, subpoenas, etc.), and gathering evidence for criminal cases prosecuted through the court system.If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GS-11 grade level.
GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, with the authority granted by the state or government to enforce laws, make arrests, and investigate crimes, performing primary duties in an official law enforcement capacity such as:* Utilizing intelligence information to track illegal operations, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or contraband while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.
* Leading investigations of fraud, contraband, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or illegal operations to determine sources and patterns while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.
* Apprehending violators of state, federal, or immigration laws by utilizing various forms of complex technology that include surveillance, detection, situation awareness systems, and/or communications equipment.

Salary and Benefits
Annual Base Salary for newly appointed BPAs varies per grade, as follows:
GL-5/GL-7 $49,739 - $89,518 per year
Duty location impacts pay rates; locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GL-5, GL-7, GL-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without reapplying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level.
Border Patrol Agents are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional ROTH 401(k) offering.
*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX; Presidio, TX; Sanderson, TX; Comstock, TX; Lordsburg, NM; Freer, TX; Hebbronville, TX; Ajo, AZ.
*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.
Duties and Responsibilities
As a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and custom laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations
* Preventing and apprehending undocumented noncitizens and smugglers of noncitizens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations
* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband
* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks
* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.Qualifications
You qualify for the GL-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience : One (1) year of general work experience that demonstrates the ability to take charge, make sound decisions, and maintain composure in stressful situations; to learn regulations, methods, and techniques through classroom training and/or on-the-job instruction; and the ability to gather concise information through questioning, observation, and examination of documents and records; OR
Education Substitution : A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; OR
Combination of Experience and Education : A combination of general work experience AND successfully completed college education. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.
You qualify for the GL-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:
Experience : One year of specialized work experience that shows you have the skills necessary to:* Make sound judgments and decisions in the use of firearms.
* Deal effectively with people in a courteous and tactful manner in connection with law enforcement matters.
* Analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions where you will be expected to make arrests after the completion of required training and apply these skills in a law enforcement capacity such as criminal code enforcement, determining violations of laws, correctional or rehabilitation work involving criminal offenders, security, military, etc.

title: Border patrol agent - experienced (gl9 / gs11)
description:
DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOW
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.
U. S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.
The U. S. Border Patrol (USBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.
If you seek an exciting and rewarding job that provides excellent pay and exceptional federal benefits, now is the time to make your move. U. S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is hiring immediately for these full-time, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.
Salary and Benefits:
Salary for newly appointed law enforcement Border Patrol Agents varies from:Base Salary: GL-9/GS-11 $63,148 - $120,145 per year
Locality Pay: Varies by duty location.
Overtime Pay: Up to 25%Duty location impacts pay rates; locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression from GL-9 to GS-11 to GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without re-applying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in the lower grade level.
All Border Patrol Agents may select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health and insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan that is similar to traditional and ROTH 401(k) offerings.
*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX; Presidio, TX; Sanderson, TX; Comstock, TX; Lordsburg, NM; Freer, TX; Hebbronville, TX; Ajo, AZ.
*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.
Duties and Responsibilities:
As a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and customs laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations.
* Preventing and apprehending aliens and smugglers of aliens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations.
* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband.
* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks.
* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.Qualifications:
GL-9: You qualify for the GL-9 grade level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as:* Performing physical searches of detained individuals, their vehicles, and their immediate surroundings for weapons, contraband, currency, and other evidence.
* Apprehending, physically restraining, or working with law enforcement officials to identify or apprehend violators of state, federal, or immigration laws.
* Proficient in the use of firearms, preparing investigative reports, serving court orders (e.g., warrants, subpoenas, etc.), and gathering evidence for criminal cases prosecuted through the court system.If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GS-11 grade level.
GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, with the authority granted by the state or government to enforce laws, make arrests, and investigate crimes, performing primary duties in an official law enforcement capacity such as:* Utilizing intelligence information to track illegal operations, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or contraband while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.
* Leading investigations of fraud, contraband, criminal activity, threats to our nation, and/or illegal operations to determine sources and patterns while serving as a state, federal, or military law enforcement official.
* Apprehending violators of state, federal, or immigration laws by utilizing various forms of complex technology that include surveillance, detection, situation awareness systems, and/or communications equipment.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. title: Copywriter pleno | linkedin
description:
Ser bom não basta. No mercado atual, só é escolhido quem é lembrado.
É o que repetimos para os nossos clientes todos os dias. E é o que você vai nos ajudar a resolver: fazer com que Founders e CEOs de empresas multimilionárias sejam tão reconhecidos quanto competentes.
Sobre a Brand You Up
A BYU nasceu em 2018 para resolver um problema específico: executivos competentes que ninguém conhecia. Desde então, já atendemos mais de 700 clientes em 3 continentes.
Somos uma agência de branding pessoal e posicionamento digital. Nosso foco são CEOs, Founders, C-Levels e Conselheiros que precisam construir autoridade no Linked In para gerar negócios, atrair talentos e se tornarem referência nos seus mercados.
O time é composto por ghostwriters, copywriters, designers, community managers e especialistas em branding. Todos em regime remoto. Nossa metodologia é proprietária e já foi aplicada em centenas de marcas pessoais.
Estamos em um momento de aceleração: novos clientes entrando a cada mês e operação em expansão. Precisamos de mais profissionais qualificados para manter o que nos trouxe até aqui ( conteúdo que não parece de agência).
Sobre o cargo
Você entra como Copywriter Pleno, contribuidor individual , dentro do time de conteúdo, reportando-se diretamente ao Head de Conteúdo.
Seu trabalho impacta diretamente a forma como nossos clientes são percebidos no mercado. Cada conteúdo que você escreve se torna o posicionamento público de um executivo. Não se trata de marketing de conteúdo genérico — é construção de reputação.

Você será responsável por 4 a 10 clientes simultaneamente
Cada um com tom de voz, histórias e objetivos próprios
O cargo é hands-on: você pesquisa, escreve, revisa, publica e analisa
Conforme a operação cresce, quem entrega bem terá oportunidade de liderar novos copywriters e assumir mais responsabilidades. No momento, buscamos alguém que escreva muito bem, seja proativo(a) e tenha afinidade com autonomia.
O que você vai fazer
Primeiros 60 dias (Ramp-up):
Entender a metodologia BYU e como adaptamos o tom de voz para cada cliente
Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com os primeiros clientes e absorver o perfil de cada um
Produzir conteúdos utilizando nosso método, com acompanhamento do Head de Conteúdo
Aprender a utilizar as ferramentas de IA dentro do nosso fluxo de trabalho
Assumir de 2 a 4 clientes
Do dia 61 ao dia 90 (Calibragem):
Receber feedback, ajustar abordagens e encontrar o ritmo de produção ideal
Assumir de 3 a 6 clientes
A partir do mês 4 (Autonomia):
Gerenciar de 4 a 10 clientes com autonomia: pautas, calendário editorial, produção e análise de desempenho
Escrever conteúdos que geram engajamento real
Criar roteiros e briefings quando o conteúdo demandar elementos visuais ou vídeo
Utilizar IA para acelerar pesquisa e gerar variações, entregando sempre texto com voz humana
Analisar métricas dos conteúdos e propor melhorias com base em dados
Manter o calendário editorial em dia de forma autônoma
Métricas que importam
Alcance e impressões dos conteúdos
Engajamento real (comentários, compartilhamentos, reações)
Crescimento de seguidores e conexões estratégicas
Consistência de publicações (cumprimento do ritmo acordado)
Geração de oportunidades e leads
Requisitos
+3 anos de experiência com produção de conteúdo ou copywriting para canais digitais
Capacidade de escrever com vozes distintas, mantendo autenticidade
Domínio da língua portuguesa (norma culta e linguagem de redes sociais)
Organização para gerenciar múltiplos clientes sem comprometer prazos ou qualidade
Experiência com ferramentas de IA generativa (Chat GPT, Claude ou similares) no fluxo de trabalho
Capacidade de consumir conteúdos em inglês (leitura e escuta)
Diferenciais
Portfólio com posts publicados no Linked In
Experiência com produção de conteúdo para executivos, founders ou figuras públicas
Conhecimento prático do algoritmo do Linked In
Habilidade em criação de capas e elementos visuais (Canva, Figma, Photoshop)
Experiência com edição de vídeos curtos (Reels, Shorts)
Histórico de posts (próprios ou de clientes) com alta viralização
Por que essa vaga e não as outras 50?
Vagas de copywriter não faltam no mercado. Então por que considerar esta?
Você escreve para pessoas, não para marcas. Cada cliente tem nome, rosto, opiniões e uma história. É ghostwriting no sentido mais puro: dar voz a quem tem muito a dizer, mas não tem tempo de escrever. Seus textos serão lidos por milhares de pessoas. Os perfis que a BYU gerencia têm audiência real. O que você escreve gera comentários, abre conversas e traz negócios. O impacto é visível toda semana. Ferramentas, não burocracia. IA paga, treinamentos internos e feedback constante do Head de Conteúdo. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento porque isso se reflete diretamente na qualidade da entrega. Crescimento concreto. A operação está crescendo agora. Quem entra neste momento e entrega bem terá espaço para assumir mais clientes, liderar outros copywriters e evoluir junto com a empresa.
Autonomia de verdade. Horário flexível, liberdade para organizar seu dia e gestão própria do calendário. O que importa é a qualidade do que é entregue.
Contratação e Benefícios PJ , 100% remoto, com necessidade de residência em São Paulo para encontros pontuais com o time. Início imediato. R$ 4.000 a R$ 6.000/mês , conforme experiência e portfólio. Treinamentos internos: investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo, não apenas nas entregas Horário flexível: o que importa é a qualidade da entrega, não o horário em que você trabalha
Recesso e férias remuneradas: mesmo no modelo PJ
O Bom e o Mau Copywriter de Linked In
O que valorizamos e o que buscamos evitar.
O Bom Copywriter estuda o cliente antes de escrever a primeira linha. Lê as entrevistas que ele concedeu, assiste aos vídeos, entende como ele se comunica. O resultado é um conteúdo que parece ter saído diretamente do executivo, não de uma agência.
O Mau Copywriter troca o nome no template e envia para aprovação. O cliente lê e percebe que aquilo não o representa.
O Bom Copywriter sabe que as duas primeiras linhas decidem o alcance de um post. Testa aberturas diferentes, analisa o desempenho da semana anterior e ajusta.
O Mau Copywriter utiliza as mesmas aberturas repetidamente, não consulta métricas e não compreende por que o engajamento está caindo.
O Bom Copywriter utiliza IA para ganhar velocidade, não para substituir o raciocínio. Gera rascunhos, pesquisa referências e testa variações. Mas o texto final passou por revisão humana cuidadosa.
O Mau Copywriter copia a saída da IA, formata e entrega. O cliente — ou qualquer leitor atento — percebe imediatamente.
O Bom Copywriter escreve com correção gramatical e tom adequado ao Linked In: profissional, porém conversacional. Encontra o equilíbrio entre formalidade e naturalidade.
O Mau Copywriter ou adota um tom excessivamente formal (como um release de assessoria) ou relaxa a ponto de deixar erros passarem. Erros em conteúdos de CEOs comprometem tanto a agência quanto o cliente.
O Bom Copywriter gerencia o próprio calendário. Cumpre prazos, comunica proativamente quando precisa de mais tempo e não confunde briefings entre clientes.
O Mau Copywriter atrasa entregas, mistura informações de clientes diferentes e depende de cobranças constantes. Com 4 a 10 clientes simultâneos, esse perfil não se sustenta.
O Bom Copywriter busca feedback ativamente e ajusta sem resistência. Entende que os primeiros textos de cada cliente fazem parte do processo de calibragem. Cada rodada de revisão é uma oportunidade de evoluir.
O Mau Copywriter interpreta correções como crítica pessoal. Defende o texto em vez de ouvir o cliente e repete os mesmos problemas.
Em resumo: buscamos alguém que trate cada perfil de cliente como se a reputação em jogo fosse a própria. Que compreenda que um post no Linked In de um CEO não é apenas conteúdo — é posicionamento. Se isso faz sentido para você, queremos conversar.
Diversidade & Inclusão
Nossas vagas são abertas a todas as pessoas, sem distinção de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.
Quer fazer parte da BYU?
Candidate-se pela Candidatura Simplificada do Linked In.

title: Bolsista doutor - aps3 - manufatura digital siemens | doutores inovando no setor empresarial - iel/pr
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.
O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.
Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .
Sobre a Oportunidade:
Você deseja atuar na vanguarda da transformação digital industrial? Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem quer impulsionar a adoção de tecnologias avançadas em manufatura e contribuir diretamente para a evolução do ecossistema MOM e IIo T no país. A APS3 está iniciando um projeto estratégico para consolidar seu protagonismo em soluções digitais, acelerando a integração entre operações, dados e inteligência industrial.
Buscamos um profissional com perfil inovador, visão sistêmica e domínio técnico para atuar no desenvolvimento aplicado, explorar novos caminhos de digitalização e apoiar a expansão de soluções que conectam processos, máquinas e pessoas. Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, indústria 4.0 e por transformar ambientes complexos em operações mais inteligentes, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, esta é a oportunidade ideal para deixar sua marca no futuro da manufatura.
Formação Acadêmica:
Doutor(a) em Engenharia de Produção, Automação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.
Projeto: Aceleração da adoção e domínio das soluções Siemens Opcenter X e Insights Hub para ampliar portfólio em MOM e IIo T

Principais Atividades:
Transformar o conhecimento desenvolvido nas soluções Siemens Opcenter X e Insights Hub em conteúdo estratégico.
Elaborar artigos técnicos voltados para MOM e IIo T.
Produzir casos de sucesso e white papers para divulgação de resultados e boas práticas.
Conduzir webinars e apresentações técnicas para educar o mercado.
Apoiar o posicionamento da APS3 como referência em soluções digitais industriais.
Impulsionar a geração de novos negócios por meio da disseminação de conteúdo qualificado.
Conhecimento necessário:
Capacidade comprovada em análise de dados industriais.
Domínio de metodologias ágeis.
Conhecimento em linguagem de programação para análise de dados e desenvolvimento.
Experiência com Power BI para visualização de dados.
Forte capacidade de pesquisa aplicada e desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para o ambiente industrial.
Conhecimento Desejável
Transformar o conhecimento desenvolvido nas soluções Siemens Opcenter X e Insights Hub em conteúdo estratégico.
Elaborar artigos técnicos voltados para MOM e IIo T.
Produzir casos de sucesso e white papers para divulgação de resultados e boas práticas.
Conduzir webinars e apresentações técnicas para educar o mercado.
Apoiar o posicionamento da APS3 como referência em soluções digitais industriais.
Impulsionar a geração de novos negócios por meio da disseminação de conteúdo qualificado.
Conhecimento em IIo T (Industrial Internet of Things).
Sólidos conhecimentos e experiência prática em Manufatura Digital.
Experiência em integração de sistemas MOM (Manufacturing Operations Management) e MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems).
Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial
Idioma: Inglês;
Formato de trabalho : Híbrido
Local: São José dos Pinhais/PR
Soft Skills: Autogestão; Pensamento crítico; Criatividade; Organização.

title: Analista de importação
description:
Gi Group , em parceria com uma empresa multinacional, estamos buscando um Analista de Importação Pleno em São Bernardo do Campo/SP.
Foco Principal:
Gerenciar o relacionamento operacional de ponta a ponta com os clientes/parceiros, a fim de honrar o compromisso do serviço e garantir a satisfação do cliente, cumprindo as exigências das solicitações de clientes, previsão, execução de pedidos, custos, logística e legislações aduaneiras.
Principais responsabilidades:
• Acompanhamento de peças (demanda) junto ao exportador de origem;
• Responder e-mails de fornecedores do exterior, contabilizar processos financeiros e material, planilhas (México e Argentina);
• Cobrança e follow up diário junto aos fornecedores de peças compradas via e-mail e telefone para cumprimento do release (EDI);
• Análise de release, comprando demanda x pedidos já fixados para posterior transmissão de EDI;
• Aprovações de pedidos manuais no sistema SAP e demais sistemas;
• Análise de listra crítica (SAP), para identificação de críticos e priorização para desembaraço e eventual colocação de pedido aéreo;
• Contato com as plantas para acompanhamento do programa de produção.
• Garantir a exatidão da documentação dos processos de importação em tempo hábil e com a qualidade necessária para o correto desembaraço aduaneiro no pais de destino.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
• Experiência com importação ou exportação;
• Experiência em logística internacional;
• Desenvolvimento estratégico de operações logísticas;
• Conhecimento em operações logísticas na cadeia de transporte;
• Analise de indicadores e relatórios da área;
• Pacote office intermediário x avançado em especial Excel;
• Inglês intermediário (leitura, escrita e conversação);
• Superior completo em: Administração, Comércio Exterior, Engenharia, Logística e áreas afins.
Requisitos desejáveis:
• Conhecimento em SAP;
• Noção em desembaraço aduaneiro;
• Atuação no segmento da indústria automobilística ou similares.
Formação acadêmica:
Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou Comércio Exterior.
Perfil desejado:
Organização e atenção aos detalhes | Capacidade de comunicação eficaz para manter clientes internos atualizados | Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e cumprir prazos | Proatividade para propor melhorias e otimizações.
Mais detalhes:
Local de trabalho: São Bernardo do Campo/SP.
Contrato: CLT Efetivo.
Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 17h | Formato Hibrido (3 X Presencial e 2 X Home Office)
Benefícios: Remuneração compatível com o mercado + Pacote completo de benefícios

title: Backfill support engineer
description:
Title: IT Support (Backfill)
Contract: Long Term
Location: Santa Rosa, Brazil
Scope of Work
This is a Backfill IT Support (Deskside Support) position for one of our clients in Jundiai, Brazil
The selected candidate will provide on-site technical support covering IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, and hardware troubleshooting. You will work closely with internal teams, customer teams, and remote technical specialists to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Responsibilities include monitoring system health, supporting network devices, troubleshooting VOIP phones, managing basic server tasks, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations following SLA guidelines.
Who We Are – Teceze
Teceze is a global IT solutions and managed services provider, delivering end-to-end support across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. We specialize in providing reliable, secure, and scalable IT services that empower organizations to operate seamlessly. By joining Teceze, you become part of a highly collaborative and technically strong team focused on excellence, innovation, and customer success.
This role is being offered as a backfill position for one of our key clients, ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining service quality on-site.
Job Description:
Basic Knowledge of Network Devices such as Switches, Routers, Wireless Access Points preferably CISCO, Riverbed
• Basics knowledge / understanding of assigning switch ports to specific VLANs
• Patch phone ports to switch as needed
• Basic troubleshooting of Avaya VOIP phones (knowledge on basic configuration)
• Troubleshoot issues with fiber links between switches – Able to visualize errors and communicate to remote technical teams
• Troubleshoot and replace network switch chassis blades when required
• Good to have understanding of any Data Center Infrastructure Management Application
• A periodic (minimum twice weekly) visual check of the IDF rooms for cooling and power status (specifically UPS alarms and PDU health) Control-M, EMC Avamar, Data Domain
• Basic Knowledge of Monitoring tools such as Solarwinds, etc…
• Networking and Operating System basics
• Assist network and data center admins (Internal, Customer and Vendor) as required during the course of technical troubleshooting
• Basic knowledge about Hardware like Servers, Storage devices
• Knowledge to understand Monitoring Tool outcome
• Basic knowledge of ITSM tool preferably Service Now
• Basic knowledge Backup technologies preferably EMC Avamar
• Basic knowledge of Operating Systems- Windows 2003 servers Enterprise/Standard Edition, UNIX & linux
• Basic knowledge about Windows 2003 Active Directory structure, MS Exchange 2003 and File/Print Server
• Experience in SLA base environment
• Knowledge on Server Performance monitoring preferred
• Candidate should have minimum 3-5 years' experience in above mentioned area give me the scope of the job and who we are and how to apply

title: Especialista de redes
description:
Convidamos você para se juntar à nossa equipe global de inovadores .
A Hexing está espalhada por mais de 90 países e somos uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a colaboração . Estamos contribuindo cada vez mais no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de energia verde para o desenvolvimento global, com foco em soluções inovadoras para um futuro sustentável .
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com oportunidades de crescimento , desenvolvimento profissional contínuo e benefícios atraentes.
Aqui na Eletra Energy (empresa do Grupo Hexing no Brasil) você terá a chance de fazer a diferença, trabalhando em projetos impactantes que moldam o futuro . Se você é apaixonado por inovação e sustentabilidade, queremos você em nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!
Descrição da vaga:
Garantir suporte de rede confiável para as operações de negócios. Monitorar e registrar métricas-chave como latência, jitter, tráfego e status de interfaces de dispositivos. Conduzir análise de requisitos, configuração padronizada, implantação e suporte operacional para redes corporativas, redes de data center (IDC) e redes em nuvem pública;
Revisar e padronizar as configurações básicas de rede; realizar de forma independente configurações padronizadas e solucionar problemas de rede com base nos ambientes atuais. Fornecer análise de causa raiz e elaborar relatórios pós-incidente;
Apoiar ativamente os departamentos de negócios por meio da análise de requisitos, fornecendo recomendações profissionais e auxiliando na implementação de novos serviços;
Coletar e responder prontamente às demandas dos usuários finais, resolver incidentes de forma eficiente e documentar as soluções em uma base de conhecimento;
Liderar a implementação de projetos de rede, incluindo instalação em sites, configuração, testes e aceite. Entregar documentação completa do projeto.
Requisitos:
Bacharelado ou ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes, Engenharia de Telecomunicações ou áreas afins;
Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada na função, incluindo operação, manutenção e design de redes em nível corporativo;
Familiaridade com protocolos de roteamento, switching, VPN, firewall, balanceadores de carga e redes em nuvem;
Experiência prática com equipamentos de fornecedores como Cisco, Huawei, H3 C, Palo Alto, F5, entre outros;
Capacidade comprovada de análise e solução de problemas, com experiência em lidar com incidentes de grande impacto;
Inglês básico.
Desejável:
Inglês intermediário/avançado;
Certificações como CCNP, HCNP ou equivalentes serão consideradas diferenciais.

title: Analista de custos sr
description:
Garantir a acuracidade das informações de custos e a rentabilidade do negócio, transformando dados operacionais em inteligência financeira para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas, a otimização de recursos e a maximização dos resultados da empresa.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:
Fechamento de Custos: Conduzir o fechamento mensal de custos, assegurando a conciliação entre estoque físico e contábil, com elevado nível de precisão e confiabilidade. Análise de Desvios: Analisar variações entre valores orçados e realizados, identificando causas, impactos financeiros e propondo ações corretivas. Análise de Rentabilidade de Clientes: Elaborar, revisar e monitorar a margem de contribuição por cliente, produto e operação. KPIs e Dashboards: Desenvolver, acompanhar e apresentar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e dashboards gerenciais para monitoramento de perdas, quebras, produtividade e eficiência operacional. Orçamento e Forecast: Apoiar a elaboração do Budget anual e realizar o Forecast mensal de custos, garantindo alinhamento com as estratégias corporativas. Melhoria Contínua de Processos: Identificar gargalos financeiros e operacionais, propondo planos de ação para redução de custos fixos e variáveis e melhoria da performance financeira. Atuação Estratégica: Reportar desvios que impactam diretamente o EBITDA, fornecendo análises críticas para suporte à alta gestão. Interface Multidisciplinar: Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de Logística, Operação e Comercial, oferecendo suporte técnico e financeiro.
Relatórios Gerenciais: Elaborar relatórios mensais executivos para Diretoria e Gerência Financeira, com análises claras, objetivas e orientadas à tomada de decisão. REQUISITOS NECESSÁ RIOS:
Sólida experiência em Controladoria e Custos , com vivência em fechamentos mensais complexos. Domínio dos métodos de custeio: Absorção, Variável e ABC . Forte atuação em análise de variações (Orçado x Realizado) e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais para alta liderança. Conhecimento avançado em contabilidade de custos e matemática financeira . Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas ou Economia . Desejável: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Finanças ou Gestão Empresarial . Excel avançado / especialista (modelagem financeira, dashboards e análise de dados)

Title: Software Developer

Summary
Our Client is seeking a skilled and motivated Software Developer to join our growing team in Brazil. This role will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of software modules for automotive applications, primarily focusing on Infotainment (IVI) and potentially Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS). Collaboration: Work closely with other developers, testers, and system engineers to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
Experience with automotive software development is highly preferred, with a focus on either Infotainment (IVI) or Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS).
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
Familiarity with software configuration management tools (e.g., Git).
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C++, C, Python).
Experience with software testing frameworks and methodologies.
Familiarity with embedded systems development is a plus.
Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) is a plus.
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet) is a plus.
Language Skills:
Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential.
Soft Skills:
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Proactive attitude and willingness to learn new technologies.

description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, empowering businesses everywhere to compete and thrive in the modern data-driven economy. We always put the Customer First.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro.
We’re looking for a Retail Client Manager who expects more from their career. It’s an opportunity to bring world leading customer data to life and make a real impact in driving change and growth for our client, and in turn grow the dunnhumby business.

Build and own strong relationships with C‑level and senior stakeholders at the retailer.
Expand dunnhumby’s network across the retailer’s value chain and act as a trusted, collaborative advisor, deeply understanding the retailer’s strategy, customers, and commercial priorities.
Establish governance routines to ensure clear priorities, progress tracking, and two‑way feedback.
Identify high‑value opportunities where dunnhumby can support the retailer and shape the workplan accordingly, overseeing and driving delivery of the client workplan to ensure measurable value.
Spot upsell opportunities and support the full sales cycle through to contract.
Collaborate across the broader dunnhumby team to present a unified, integrated approach to the client.
Lead, coach, and performance‑manage the Retail Client team to deliver against account goals.
Mitigate risks, demonstrate dunnhumby’s values, and ensure team members have the required skills and training.
Measure value delivery regularly, including ROI analytics and client impact surveys.
Support contract renewal efforts and partner with the account lead to maximize renewal success.
Stay informed on global retail trends and share insights with client stakeholders.
Manage the account P& L, ensuring financial performance and value creation.
Fluent English Speaker.

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.
And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One and dh Thrive as the living proof. Everyone’s invited.

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Remote biomedical informatics sme - 58854
description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Role Overview:
We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.
This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. Responsibilities:
Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.
Required Qualifications:
Educational Background
Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
Ongoing Ph D with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
Ph D (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).
Technical and other skills Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets. Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.). Solid programming skills in Python / R Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control. Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams
Domain Expertise Requirements
Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:
1. Biomedical Image Processing
Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
Computational segmentation and boundary inference
Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
Noise modeling and statistical denoising
Image sampling theory and resolution limits
Intensity standardization and harmonization
Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
Multi-modal image registration and alignment
Morphological and topological shape analysis
Quantitative imaging feature extraction
Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
pattern recognition and predictive modeling 2. Biomedical Signal Processing
Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing 3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine
Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
Molecular patient subtyping
Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ct DNA, cf RNA/mi RNA, MRD, etc.)
Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science 4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing
Treatment response prediction
Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
Protein structure analysis (PDB/mm CIF handling)
Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2 D/3 D data handling and chemical space analysis)
QSAR & ADMET Modeling
Drug–target interaction prediction
Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
Repurposing via omics/network associations
Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis ) 5. Software / Utilities
Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3 D viewers)
Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
Batch processing and report generation
Pipeline interoperability checks
Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors 6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies
FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
Data & Content Compliance
Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
Model Use Governance & Auditability
Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
Clinical validation and cohort generalization
Privacy‑preserving learning
Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
Work in a fully remote environment.
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

title: Senior c/c++ engineer with python
description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips.
